selection_reason: Small multilingual retrieval encoder with 384-dimensional vectors; model language list includes English, Hindi, Kannada and Marathi. Runs locally on CPU without a paid API. Low-resource language quality still requires separate evaluation.
long_chunk_policy: Non-overlapping token windows with bounded structural context; token-weighted mean of normalized window vectors, then normalize to one vector per original chunk. No source text is discarded or changed.
abstention_policy: Uncalibrated baseline: no hits or maximum cosine similarity below 0.70 is a candidate. Similarity is not evidence of factual support. Human support review is required; labels and expected sources never influence retrieval or this heuristic.
